thread:
Maya: FYI — starting a short sync thread for packaging + netops handoff for Private upgrade path. Need a clear upgrade checklist + customer-managed networking constraints. Draft infra doc: https://redwood.link/priv-upgrade-draft

Sam: Quick Q — do we intend to require customers to open specific egress ports or support NAT via our edge? Some customers want to own NAT.

Maya: Customers can own NAT. For MVP we need a deterministic handshake path: outbound to control-plane endpoints over 443, and inbound only for agent-initiated tunnels. We'll document port list.

Akihiro: Action: add CNI compatibility matrix. Calico, Cilium tested. Flannel = unsupported for now.

Liz: Rolling upgrades: we need agent version pin + canary rollout steps. If agent fails healthcheck, auto-rollback to previous image.

Maya: Agreed. MVP acceptance: zero customer traffic loss for control-plane calls during upgrade for <=12 node clusters. If we can't meet that, downgrade to maintenance window.

Sam: For airgapped installs, packaging will be a tarball + installer. Need checksums and offline KMS flow.

deploy-bot: deploy-plan-check — found 1 missing artifact in packaging pipeline (artifact: private-installer-v0.1.2.tar.gz)

Maya: I'll follow up with infra to ensure build publishes. Akihiro will own packaging QA.

Akihiro: Taking ownership. I'll add a small smoke test: verify 1) agent registers, 2) model pull respects offline cache.

Liz: Networking note: customers asking for BYO ingress LB in VPC. We should support NAT gateway + SG rules guide. Draft snippet:
```
required_outbound: ["control.redwood.ai:443", "metrics.redwood.ai:443"]
allowed_inbound: ["agent-initiated" -> ephemeral ports]
```

Maya: We should also include rollback commands and a short emergency cutover play:
- scale down router
- redirect traffic to hosted fallback
- revert agent image

Sam: Prioritization: propose MVP features: 1) VPC with customer-managed NAT, 2) on-prem installer (airgap optional), 3) rolling upgrade with canary, 4) compatibility matrix. Everything else -> phase 2.

Liz: +1. Suggest add telemetry gating for quality regressions in canary.

Maya: Owners & due dates:
- Packaging QA (Akihiro) — due 2026-04-15
- Networking docs (Sam) — due 2026-03-30
- Rollout playbook (Liz) — due 2026-03-25
- Build publish fix (Infra) — ASAP

Akihiro: I'll post a short PR with tests and checklist today.

Sam: I'll draft SG/NAT guide and include example CloudFormation snippet.

Maya: Cool. If no objections, I'll convert this into a short RFC and schedule a 30m sync next Tue. :thumbsup:

Liz: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: reminder — scheduled sync created: Tue 2026-03-24 10:00 PT

Maya: Thanks — closing thread for now, will attach RFC link when ready.
